title: Ms. Marvel
summary: Kamala, a superhero fan with an imagination--particularly when it comes to Captain Marvel--feels like she doesn't fit in at school and sometimes even at home, that is until she gets superpowers like the heroes she admires. (source: IMDb)

reception.director: Adil El Arbi, Bilall Fallah, Meera Menon, Sharmeen Obaid-Chinoy
reception.actors: Iman Vellani, Matt Lintz, Zenobia Shroff, Rish Shah
reception.awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 6 wins & 22 nominations total.
